departments.name: Sales
departments.summary: Sales manages customer relationships, prepares quotes, and oversees key customer accounts.

work.task: lead sales team and key accounts

evidence.quote: Leads the sales team and key customer accounts.

work.task: prepare quotes and manage customer relationships

evidence.quote: Prepares customer quotes and manages customer relationships.

departments.name: Operations
departments.summary: Operations manages departmental operations and initiates operational purchase requests.

evidence.quote: Approves departmental purchase needs and business necessity.

departments.name: Finance
departments.summary: Finance validates purchase requests, checks customer credit, and processes supplier invoice payments.

evidence.quote: Validates amounts, policy rules, and required approvals.
Matches supplier invoices to purchase orders and processes payments.
Approved quotes are sent to Finance, which checks the customer's credit limit before the order is confirmed.

departments.name: Procurement
departments.summary: Procurement sources vendor quotes, selects suppliers, executes purchase orders, and handles follow-up.

work.task: select vendors and approve purchase orders

evidence.quote: Selects vendors and approves purchase orders.

work.task: request quotes and place purchase orders

evidence.quote: Requests vendor quotes and places purchase orders.
Procurement is responsible for vendor selection, purchase execution, and order follow-up.
After all required management and finance approvals are complete, the request is handed to the Procurement Department.
Once the order is placed, Procurement sends the supplier invoice to Finance for payment.
Approved quotes are sent to Finance, which checks the customer's credit limit before the order is confirmed.
